evidence: Pinned Tropp2011 Prop3.1 pp9-10 and admitted source-only graph v2.1, plus actual inspection of pinned Mathlib scalar Markov declaration; new Lean target remains unproved.

metadata.conclusion_map: A scalar upper-tail Chernoff/Laplace interface corresponds to the algebraic-largest-eigenvalue trace-exponential interface. A two-sided operator-norm tail requires two actual signed inputs and an explicit union/inclusion step. The proposed Gaussian consumer is only its four actual fixed-s spectral-tail cases with internally finite Bochner RHS.
metadata.failure_boundary: lambda_max is not operator norm on indefinite matrices. Normalized trace can fail to dominate the largest exponential eigenvalue. Nonpositive s changes or destroys the event scaling; infinite-dimensional/unbounded spectra require different hypotheses. Source s>0 coefficients never use a floating underflow zero. No all-s finite Bochner mgf, equal positive/negative mgfs, arbitrary operator-exp monotonicity, noncommuting product mgf, Lieb/independent-sum/master-tail/Bernstein/C6/main-bound/oracle/cost conclusion follows from this bridge.
metadata.formal_shared_floor: The same compiled MeasureTheory.meas_ge_le_lintegral_div is an inspected candidate floor; actual proof constant edges remain pending new compilation. No cloned scalar Markov API is proposed.
metadata.formula: Scalar: P(Z>=t)<=inf_{s>0} exp(-st) E exp(sZ). Matrix: P(lambda_max(A)>=t)<=inf_{s>0} exp(-st) E tr exp(sA), with nonnegative scalar extended expectations and ordinary trace.
metadata.global_graph_integration: Held by original stabilization lane; this is only a raw typed Discovery proposal, not a graph file mutation or mathematical VERIFIED.
metadata.hypothesis_map: Both branches use a probability law, a measurable or ae-measurable source random object, s>0 and every real threshold t. The matrix branch additionally uses finite nonempty self-adjoint real matrices (ae) and ordinary unnormalized trace. Neither interface assumes centering, independence, a norm cap, variance bound or all-parameter finite matrix mgfs.
metadata.key_estimate: On the ae self-adjoint source domain, exp(s lambda_max(A))<=tr exp(sA); exp(st)>0 is finite, so the Markov coefficient exp(-st) is finite and strictly positive even for negative thresholds. Scalar extended expectations may be infinite.
metadata.mechanism: Replace a tail event by a superlevel event of a nonnegative observable, then apply the same canonical scalar Markov inequality. In the matrix branch, same-operator spectral calculus supplies exp(s lambda_max(A))<=tr exp(sA); the scalar branch needs no spectral adapter. This is a recurring source mechanism between complete tail interfaces, not a certified scalar-to-matrix theorem transport.
metadata.source_expectation_boundary: P is the real specialization with disclosed nonnegative scalar extended-expectation domain completion, not a claim that Tropp literally specifies ENNReal or extended matrix mgfs.
